summary.title: Identifying missing settings key and present alternative
summary.body:
The missing key is `"rate"`. The code looks it up with `SETTINGS.get("rate")` at `app/pricing.py:8`.

What's there instead is `"rat"` with the value `0.5`, at `settings.json:2`. It's the same name with the final "e" missing, so `.get("rate")` finds nothing and returns `None`.
